params.prompt: High-end modern website design for ATLAS GROUP, a Michigan real estate, insurance, mortgage and construction company. Crisp flat UI screenshot, no device mockup. Palette true white #FFFFFF, ink navy #14263D, vivid blue #3268F5. Modern light-medium weight grotesk typography like Manrope. Airy asymmetrical editorial design, square-corner media, 64px outer gutters, fine horizontal rules. Simple outlined arrow icons. No gradients except neutral black readability fade over hero photo. No fake metrics, awards, testimonials, invented team members or fake listings. All text is readable and implementable in HTML/CSS. Standalone website brand story and process section. Light cool-gray #F4F6F8 background. Left 46% large portrait photograph of a tree-lined Michigan neighborhood in warm afternoon light, traditional brick homes, contemporary renovations. Right 54% contains small OUR APPROACH label with blue dash, 54px heading "Forward thinking. Michigan grounded." and paragraph "Atlas brings property, protection, financing, and building into one conversation. Local experience. A clearer way forward." Under the paragraph are three numbered steps in open rows with subtle separators: 01 Start with your goals / Tell us what you have in mind.; 02 See the whole picture / Connect the right services and people.; 03 Move forward, together / Take the next step with a clear plan. At bottom right text link "Meet Atlas" and arrow. Sophisticated editorial spacing, no cards.
